# WonderMr (Alexey Zhuchkov)

> Open-source projects by GitHub user WonderMr: AI agent tooling, desktop utilities and 1C:Enterprise administration tools.

Each repository below has an AGENTS.md with layout, commands and conventions for coding agents. Most also have their own llms.txt.

## AI agents and desktop apps

- [Agents-Core](https://github.com/IEZhu/Agents): local MCP server with specialist personas, Markdown workflows, per-repository memory and validated subagent handoffs for Claude, Codex, Cursor and other AI clients
- [blincho](https://github.com/WonderMr/blincho): free screen break reminder for macOS, Windows and Linux (https://blincho.app)
- [shi](https://github.com/IEZhu/shi): local meeting transcriber for macOS with on-device speech-to-text and speaker diarization
- [sshgate](https://github.com/IEZhu/sshgate): opens a ufw firewall port for your current IP via a secret HTTPS link + TOTP
- [class](https://github.com/IEZhu/class): self-hosted platform for a small English class with LiveKit video rooms

## 1C:Enterprise tooling

- [Nikita](https://github.com/IEZhu/Nikita): exports 1C event logs to ClickHouse, Solr and Redis
- [Loggie](https://github.com/WonderMr/Loggie): 1C 8.3 extension that logs before/after data changes to the event log
- [C1Updater](https://github.com/WonderMr/C1Updater): PowerShell script for unattended 1C 8.3 configuration updates
- [bash1c](https://github.com/WonderMr/bash1c): Bash and Perl scripts to analyse 1C tech logs and event logs
- [gobbix](https://github.com/WonderMr/gobbix): Go Windows service that checks 1C infobase availability and sends Telegram alerts
- [ZH1C](https://github.com/WonderMr/ZH1C): 1C 8.3 helper extension
- [Linter1](https://github.com/WonderMr/Linter1): experimental OneScript formatter for 1C BSL code
